rows: TR-01 — AI triage and clinical decision support
The AI triage tool proposes a low priority for a patient whose condition worries you. What do you do?

You follow the tool’s proposal ; You reassess the patient, decide on your clinical judgement, then record the gap ; You wait for a colleague’s opinion without noting anything ; You change the data entered to get another priority
TR-01 — AI triage and clinical decision support
Before reading the triage tool’s proposal, you must first:
Check that the vital signs and the reason entered are complete and accurate ; Print the patient record ; Warn the head doctor ; Nothing in particular
TR-01 — AI triage and clinical decision support
What must the record of an AI-assisted triage decision contain?
Only the final priority ; The proposed priority, the priority chosen and the reason for any gap ; The name of the software vendor ; The expected waiting time
The AI tool flags a “suspected nodule” on an X-ray. The right reflex is:
Consider the diagnosis made ; Send the flag to the radiologist with the image, without concluding yourself ; Delete the flag if it looks wrong ; Wait for the next examination
A “false positive” of the imaging tool means:
The tool flags an anomaly that does not exist ; The tool misses an anomaly that is present ; The image is blurred ; The patient refused the examination
Why check the image quality before the AI analysis?
To keep to the schedule ; Because a poor-quality image can distort the tool’s result ; To reduce the dose ; It is not useful
TR-03 — Ethics and protection of health data when using AI
A suggestion from an AI tool must be:
Applied without checking ; Checked and compared with professional judgement before acting ; Always ignored ; Validated by the IT department
TR-03 — Ethics and protection of health data when using AI
Which data must never be entered in an unauthorised public AI tool?
The name of the course ; A patient’s identification data ; Today’s date ; The name of the department
TR-03 — Ethics and protection of health data when using AI

Report it and record the incident ; Start again until you get the expected result ; Say nothing ; Stop using the computer
